sections.why: News-style ‘Is Football Really Selling Us Food?’ plus food/cheesehead slices and the subtitle that football was invented to sell food — the two-year Super Bowl conspiracy.
‘Build Your Own Super Bowl Commercial’ modular cards with + buttons — poke-bowl style ad builder, just like ordering food.
Six-panel modular cast (Addison, Tramell, Parker and others) each with a food card and + — the 36-hour shoot as selectable ingredients, no results title card.
Research UI: PROMPT → INTERACTIVE WORLD (skiing Alps) with WASD — Genie 3 demo interface built for the model, not consumers.
Photoreal climber on a snow ridge, no chrome — AI as the product: a walkable world you can step into.
Consumer Create UI: ‘Let’s start by sketching your world’ with Environment / Character text fields and Create sketch.
Fan in a three-stripe adidas tracksuit in a grainy crowd — 1990s football/fashion/music DNA lived by the generations, not a Gallagher close-up.
Liam and Noel together, low angle, black void, oasis patch — first time the brothers share the frame.
Crowd holding a white adidas sneaker aloft — fans plus the Live ’25 collection, not a tour-screening title.
Packed Pacaembu, Gaviões tifo, no barcode yet — ‘one of Brazil’s most iconic stadiums’ before the naming-rights pitch is used.
Sunset aerial of the pitch mown as a 104 m barcode. Rejected the FIELD BARCODE title-lockup at 30s.
Phone in the stands scanning the pitch: Mercado Livre 25% OFF gloves and BUY NOW — live shop from the seats, no broadcast-player chrome.
Grid of Clash Royale clone icons (Soccer Royale, King Royale, Tiny Clash…) — a decade of name/art/gameplay copies.
Archer, Barbarian and goblin stuck in a cheap BASH ROYALE arena — the amnesty film’s knock-off world, not the KEEP THE GAINS title.
Transfer-site phone: ‘Do you play a Copycat?’, 3+ years, battles/day — evidence form, not a results card.
Two empty rooftop chairs over Manhattan and ‘/ Warmth was never about the outside. /’ — luxury warmth as people coming close, before the duo reveal.
Platon B&W studio: Pacino and De Niro, Moncler patch, hand on a shoulder — first fashion ad together.
Urban bus-shelter poster of the duo — campaign in the world (OOH/print), not a ‘Moncler Presents’ title.
Empty Wisła stadium, seats spelling WISŁA / 1906 — relegation and attendance gone, before any luck overlay.
Cheering fan with LUCKY FAN INDEX 79.7 overlay — a personal 100-point luck score, not the UNIVERSAL FOOTBALL SUPERSTITION title.
Three phones: category scores, top 8%, possession-when-you-attended — the index platform, cleaner than the VIP BOX title.
Faroe hills, sheep, sea, and Faroe Islands / SKF / Minesto lockup — the real remote tidal project, not a Reuters title.
Embroidered MOON POWER mission patch on blue kit — tidal energy reframed as an Earth space programme.
Yellow Luna kite in the water, Faroe Islands Space Program on the wing — the 1.2 MW hardware, not the 40% by 2030 results card.
Miniature sidewalk café tables and checkered chairs — the café people still believe holds the real cup. Demo film has no 72% home-vs-café graphic.
Japanese Magnifica Kissa machine-as-shop, hand placing a poured cup — the machine is the café, handmade not CGI.
Lineup of all five city shops (Milan, Paris, Tokyo, Berlin, Copenhagen) — the finished handmade set.
Farmer carrying a milk churn through a Kenyan parlor, cows in stalls, subtitle that antibiotic treatment means a 3–5 day withdrawal — income stops when milk must be withheld.
Cows and a farmer with feed, plus ‘Sick Leave.’ and the labour-law line that an employee is entitled to seven days’ sick leave with full pay — cows as economic workers.
WhatsApp in hand, laptop leave dashboard, and APPLICATION DETAILS for Agnes Kabura / Molly64 with prescription uploaded — request, vet docs, and review in one frame.
